source_or_custodian: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME: UNICEF, WHO, World Bank, UN Population Division), via World Development Indicators (WB_WDI) in World Bank Data360
status_or_notes: No value for 2025: the series ends at 2024 (latest data 2024), so 2000-2024 are returned (25 of the 26 requested years). The server returned no confidence intervals. Another series with the same name exists in Human Capital Project (WB_HCP_U5MORT, 1960-2024), but was not queried.
definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.
